connector.name: Btp Sap Odata To MCP Server Optimized
connector.registryDescription: Enterprise SAP OData to MCP Server with AI capabilities and Cloud Foundry integration
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package btp-sap-odata-to-mcp-server. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the raistlin82 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.
